|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Courage Of A Skywalker (V)]] (version 2 of 3). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 25 release sheet (PDF created 10 August 2025), cut unchanged from page 8. The current text is [[Courage Of A Skywalker (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' ([[Courage Of A Skywalker (V)]]): PC card image of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-cs-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/782182256b44863b5363404bf248c0502ee71360/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/courageofaskywalker.gif courageofaskywalker.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/782182256b44863b5363404bf248c0502ee71360 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark.  Text: “If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, destiny +2 when drawn for destiny. Take a lightsaber into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. OR Retrieve Anakin's Lightsaber. OR Once per game, during a battle or duel involving a Skywalker and a Dark Jedi, make a just drawn destiny = 2.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). The printed footer identifies the August 2025 edition; the PDF creation date is file metadata.</ref>, page 8, file created 10 August 2025: “If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, destiny +2 when drawn for destiny. Take a lightsaber into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. OR Retrieve Anakin's Lightsaber. OR Once per game, during a battle or duel involving a Skywalker and a Dark Jedi, make a just drawn destiny = 2.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Courage Of A Skywalker (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Courage Of A Skywalker”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Courage Of A Skywalker (V)]] (repository revision 7 August 2025) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Courage Of A Skywalker]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Courage Of A Skywalker (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image of 9 March 2026<ref name="ht-cs-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/courageofaskywalker.gif courageofaskywalker.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae 6f23e07] (9 March 2026).</ref>, marked “E1”. What changed from the previous image: PC Tweak Set errata (marked “E1”): the whole text is replaced. “If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, destiny +2 when drawn for destiny.” and “Take a lightsaber into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. OR Retrieve Anakin's Lightsaber.” become “If your Skywalker in battle alone with a character of greater ability, add one battle destiny. OR Deploy a lightsaber on a Skywalker from Lost Pile (or Force Pile; reshuffle).”; the last option drops “and a Dark Jedi”. Text: “If your Skywalker in battle alone with a character of greater ability, add one battle destiny. OR Deploy a lightsaber on a Skywalker from Lost Pile (or Force Pile; reshuffle). OR Once per game, during a battle or duel involving a Skywalker, make a just drawn destiny = 2.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata).
